text:
ria: Quick design review — compact invite modal + audit-log nav shortcuts + SSO toggle copy. Pushed a small Figma file to the drive. Looking for thoughts on copy, keyboard flow, and aria nits. cc @alex @tom

alex: :eyes: Skimming now. Main thing — compact modal reduces horizontal space for the roles matrix. If we collapse role descriptions we must ensure they are keyboard accessible (not just hover).

tom: Agree. Collapsible rows are fine if they expose a clear focus target and aria-expanded. Proposed tab order: email input -> role dropdown -> add-more -> send button. Also keep an inline error spot for bulk-invite failures.

kevin: Accessibility nits: contrast on the compact toast is low (14px body on #f7f7f9). Also the SSO toggle label is ambiguous — unsure if toggle state communicates "enforced" vs "recommended".

ria: For SSO copy I tried two variants: 'SSO enforced' and 'SSO required'. Which reads clearer to you all?

alex: "Required" is more user-facing. "Enforced" sounds like infra language.

kevin: I prefer a slightly longer explicit copy: "SSO enforced — single sign-on required for all members". Also add an aria-label for screen readers, e.g. `aria-label=\"SSO enforcement: required\"`.

kevin: Example snippet for the switch (for devs):

```html
<button role=\"switch\" aria-checked=\"true\" aria-label=\"SSO enforcement: required\">On</button>
```

tom: About the audit log nav: propose a quick keyboard shortcut to focus the audit search (like pressing `/`) and dedicated filter chips for `role changes`, `invites`, `auth events`. Chips should be tabbable and have aria-pressed states.

ria: Love the `/` shortcut idea. Need to double-check we don't clash with other global shortcuts in the console.

alex: Microcopy for bulk invite errors: current text "Some invites failed" is too vague. Suggest: "7 addresses couldn't be invited — invalid or already in org. Download CSV for details." Also include a clear retry CTA.

kevin: Add an aria-live region for the error summary so screen reader users get immediate feedback. And show icon + text (color + icon) rather than color alone for scanning.

ria: Next steps: alex to update Figma with collapsible role-row and explicit focus styles; tom to mock audit log chips + `/` shortcut behaviour; kevin to propose final aria labels and contrast values. I'll review the updated comps tomorrow morning. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
